name: Justin T. Quinn
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed May 29, 2024 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 3.

biography.text: Quinn earned a B.A. from Caldwell University (2004) and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (2010). Before law school he worked in the District of New Jersey clerk’s office and as then-Magistrate Judge Esther Salas’s courtroom deputy. He practiced at Gibbons, clerked for Judge Salas, and was a partner at Robinson Miller before appointment.
